paper_title: Raised Leptin and Pappalysin2 cell-free RNAs as hallmarks of pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia with fetal growth restriction
prediction_task: Binary classification of PE+FGR pregnancies versus uncomplicated controls (1:4 case-control) from maternal plasma cfRNA at 12/20/28/36 weeks gestation

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Discovery/validation split by preterm (<37wk) vs term (>=37wk) delivery may bias model to early-onset disease markers; early-onset placental insufficiency is biologically distinct from late-onset.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Re-analyzed by pooling both cohorts into combined 28wk set; LEP+PAPPA2 still selected; combined-model external AUC (0.944) slightly lower than original preterm-only model (0.951). Added Supplementary Data 9.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Only n=13-15 effective cases in discovery cohort at 28wk severely constrains multivariable model stability; 2-predictor ceiling is a symptom of underpowering.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Acknowledged case count limitation; justified 2-predictor model as mitigation. External validation on Munchel cohort (AUC 0.95) supports stability.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: AdaBoost (used by Munchel et al) omitted from 11-model super-learner comparison; rationale for excluding ensembles undocumented.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added AdaBoost to evaluation; results included in updated Table 2 and Figure 3A.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Labelling 17 genes as 'core genes' from overlap of DESeq2/edgeR/AUC/AIC without rationale reconciling divergent statistical assumptions of each ranking method appears arbitrary.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Reworded 'core genes' to 'shared genes' throughout manuscript; expanded justification of multi-method overlap approach.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Longitudinal sampling structure (same patient sampled at 4 gestational timepoints in same batch) not leveraged; model trained only on 28wk cross-sectional snapshot despite data being ideal for repeated-measures analysis.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added longitudinal mixed-effects analysis in new Figure 5B and Supplementary Figures 4-6; identified 129 gestation-associated cfRNAs via random-intercept models with quadratic GA terms.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Full AUC may overweight irrelevant ROC regions; partial AUC (pAUC) at high specificity recommended for clinically meaningful screening performance ranking.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Declined to switch to pAUC; retained AUC given nascent cfRNA antenatal diagnostics field lacks prior on specificity thresholds, full ROC plots provided for readers.
